summary_en: Asahi Mutual Life announced on 9 October 2024 that it will launch "Asahi no Ichijibarai Shushin" on 2 December 2024. It is a single-premium whole life policy (formally a whole life insurance with interest-rate dividends every five years). The death benefit is fixed in yen at contracting and exceeds the premium paid. summary_en: Asahi Mutual Life announced on 1 December 2025 that it has agreed with The Manufacturers Life Insurance Company to start the process of buying all shares of Vietnam's MVI Life for about USD 170 million (about JPY 26.3 billion). Completion is planned after approvals from Japanese and Vietnamese regulators, and no completion date is given. This is Asahi's first overseas insurer acquisition. It will partner with the insurtech firm LivWell on products and technology, and it plans to build overseas business as a future earnings pillar.
